title: Famous languages and software and the person who created them

VALUES ?cls { wd:Q9143 wd:Q7397 wd:Q9135 wd:Q1301371 wd:Q1502887 } ?d wdt:P31 wd:Q5 . FILTER(?sl >= 40) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nMaker = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . creator.match: Match each language or program to the person who created it.

rows.label: Python
rows.creator: Guido van Rossum
rows.hook: is a beginner-friendly language named after a British comedy troupe

rows.label: Rust
rows.creator: Graydon Hoare
rows.description: memory-safe programming language without garbage collection

rows.label: JavaScript
rows.creator: Brendan Eich
rows.hook: is the language that makes web pages interactive, running in every browser

rows.label: C++
rows.creator: Bjarne Stroustrup
rows.hook: is an object-oriented successor to a classic systems language, widely used for games and browsers

rows.label: Java
rows.creator: James Gosling
rows.hook: promised to write once and run anywhere, and long powered Android apps

rows.label: Git
rows.creator: Linus Torvalds
rows.hook: tracks changes to source code, letting many developers work on the same project

rows.label: Node.js
rows.creator: Ryan Dahl
rows.hook: lets JavaScript run on servers outside the browser

rows.label: LaTeX
rows.creator: Leslie Lamport
rows.hook: is a typesetting system widely used for scientific papers full of math

rows.label: Perl
rows.creator: Larry Wall
rows.description: interpreted programming language first released in 1987
rows.hook: is a scripting language famous for text processing and dubbed the duct tape of the internet

rows.label: Ruby
rows.creator: Yukihiro Matsumoto
rows.hook: is a language designed to make programmers happy and known for its Rails web framework

rows.label: Vim
rows.creator: Bram Moolenaar
rows.description: text editor, improved version of Vi

rows.label: Notepad++
rows.creator: Don Ho
rows.description: text editor and source code editor for Windows
rows.hook: is a free Windows text editor that is a popular upgrade over the built-in one

rows.label: SQLite
rows.creator: D. Richard Hipp
rows.hook: is a tiny database engine that runs inside apps and phones with no server

rows.label: PowerShell
rows.creator: Jeffrey Snover
rows.description: cross-platform command-line interface and scripting language for system and network administration
rows.hook: is Microsoft's command-line shell and scripting language for automating administration

rows.label: TeX
rows.creator: Donald Knuth
rows.hook: is a typesetting system whose version numbers converge toward pi
